title: NEFSC - Milford Lab Main Building Structural Assessment and Temporary Shoring
agency: COMMERCE, DEPARTMENT OF > NATIONAL OCEANIC AND ATMOSPHERIC ADMINISTRATION > DEPT OF COMMERCE NOAA
description: The NEFSC is seeking a contractor to provide structural engineering services to evaluate multiple instances of observed structural distress within Building # 1 at the National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) Northeast Fisheries Science Center (NEFSC) Milford Lab in Milford, Connecticut. The Contractor will perform a comprehensive structural assessment, provide an inspection report, deliver a temporary shoring design using Government Furnished post shores, and implement a monitoring program.
